The basicstats package contains a few basic statistical functions. The
Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Coefficient
of Determination (R2) and correlation functions compute metrics between
two sets of data. The accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, precision and
negative predictive value (NPV) compute regression metrics for confusion
matrices.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`MAE()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/MAE.md)
  : Calculate mean absolute error
- [`NPV()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/NPV.md)
  : Calculate Negative Predictive Value
- [`R2()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/R2.md)
  : Calculate R-squared
- [`RMSE()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/RMSE.md)
  : Calculate root mean squared error
- [`accuracy()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/accuracy.md)
  : Calculate accuracy
- [`correlation()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/correlation.md)
  : Calculate correlation between observed and predicted values
- [`precision()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/precision.md)
  : Calculate precision
- [`sensitivity()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/sensitivity.md)
  : Calculate sensitivity
- [`specificity()`](https://linaskog.github.io/Advanced-Bioinformatics/reference/specificity.md)
  : Calculate specificity
